```{r B cell senescence}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

#read the rds
data <- readRDS("/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 5/Figure 5B/Raw Data/All_merged_after_integration_annotated_20260225.rds")

#subset the spatial seurat object to only identify the B cell population

bcell_obj <- subset(data, idents = "B cells")

#get the B cell associated senescence geneset from scRNA seq analyses as identified in Figure 4B

sen_gene <- read.csv("/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 5/Figure 5D-E/Data input/Sig_Bcell_ senescence_genes.csv") # this geneset has all the genes included after the gsea analyses and were linked to B cell senescence

sc_sig <- sen_gene$Genes

#score the signature in Visium

bcell_obj <- AddModuleScore(bcell_obj, features = list(sc_sig), name = "Sen_signature")

#get a mean and median score for the senescnece signature across all the samples
df <- as.data.frame(
  bcell_obj@meta.data[, c("sample", "Sen_signature1")]
)

sample_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(Sen_signature1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(Sen_signature1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Comparison 

```{r DESeq2 analyses}
library(DESeq2)

#extract counts information
counts <- GetAssayData(bcell_obj, layer = "counts")

#create high and low senescence groups

median_score <- median(bcell_obj$Sen_signature1, na.rm = TRUE)

bcell_obj$sen_group <- ifelse(
  bcell_obj$Sen_signature1 > median_score,
  "High",
  "Low"
)

# add conditions column by making a vector
condition_map <- c(
  "copd1" = "COPD",
  "copd2" = "COPD",
  "copd3" = "COPD",
  "nonsmoker1" = "NS",
  "nonsmoker2" = "NS",
  "nonsmoker3" = "NS",
  "smoker1" = "Sm"
)
bcell_obj@meta.data$condition <- condition_map[
  bcell_obj@meta.data$sample
]

#Aggregate counts per condition and sen_state
library(Matrix)

meta <- bcell_obj@meta.data

meta$group_id <- paste(
  meta$sample,
  meta$sen_group,
  sep = "_"
)

# Reorder metadata to match count matrix columns
meta <- meta[colnames(counts), ]

pseudobulk_counts <- rowsum(
  t(as.matrix(counts)),
  group = meta$sample
)

pseudobulk_counts <- t(pseudobulk_counts)

#pseudobulk based on high and low senescence score

pseudobulk_counts_sen <- rowsum(
  t(as.matrix(counts)),
  group = meta$group_id
)

pseudobulk_counts_sen <- t(pseudobulk_counts_sen)


sample_info <- data.frame(
row.names = colnames(pseudobulk_counts_sen)
)

# Extract sample name
sample_info$sample <- sapply(
  strsplit(colnames(pseudobulk_counts_sen), "_"),
  `[`, 1
)

# Extract senescence group
sample_info$sen_group <- sapply(
  strsplit(colnames(pseudobulk_counts_sen), "_"),
  `[`, 2
)

# Get condition from original metadata
sample_info$condition <- bcell_obj@meta.data[
  match(sample_info$sample, bcell_obj$sample),
  "condition"
]

# Convert to factors
sample_info$sen_group <- factor(sample_info$sen_group)
sample_info$condition <- factor(sample_info$condition)

head(sample_info)

#perform DESeq2

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = pseudobulk_counts_sen,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ condition + sen_group
)

# Set NS as the reference for condition
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = "NS")

# Set High as the reference for sen_group
dds$sen_group <- relevel(dds$sen_group, ref = "Low")

# Re-run DESeq
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Check the coefficient names again
resultsNames(dds)

res_copd <- results(dds, name="condition_COPD_vs_NS")
res_sen <- results(dds, name="sen_group_High_vs_Low")

# Significant genes with padj < 0.05
sig_res_copd <- res_copd[which(res_copd$padj < 0.05), ]

sig_res_sen_strict <- res_sen[
  which(res_sen$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_sen$log2FoldChange) > 1),
]

head(sig_res_sen_strict)

write.csv(as.data.frame(sig_res_sen_strict),
          file="/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 5/High_vs_Low_senescence_strict.csv")

sig_res_strict <- res_copd[
  which(res_copd$padj < 0.05
        & abs(res_copd$log2FoldChange) > 2.5),
]

head(sig_res_strict)

write.csv(as.data.frame(sig_res_strict),
          file="/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 5/COPD_vs_NS_significant.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)


#subset to your genes for z score

sig_genes <- rownames(sig_res_strict)  # the ones you filtered earlier


vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

mat_copd <- assay(vsd)[sig_genes, ]

#convert to z-score
zmat_copd <- t(scale(t(mat_copd)))

head(zmat_copd)

write.csv(zmat_copd, file="~/Desktop/Figure 5/zscore_copd_vs_ns.csv", row.names = TRUE)

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
